answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents lock collateral in an escrow vault and submit cryptographic stake burning proofs when forging identities. Each identity registration burns tokens according to a superlinear cost curve, scaling quadratic friction C(n) ~ n^2. Raw assets, like digital ivory contracts or tokenized timber reserves, incur steep compounding penalties if recycled, rendering large-scale forged agent swarms exponentially cost-prohibitive.
